metadata.title: refactor(tests): unify live-gateway dirs, use uv run
metadata.author: jonpspri

description:
## Summary

- Migrate every Makefile pytest target to `uv run pytest` — `make test` no longer requires `make install-dev` or `source venv/bin/activate`.
- Consolidate live-infrastructure tests under `tests/live_gateway/` (mcp + sso + e2e_rust + protocol_compliance + helpers) with a single `--ignore` and a new `make test-live-gateway` umbrella target.
- Move dev-only deps (playwright, fuzz) from `[project.optional-dependencies]` to the dev group; rewire `fuzz-atheris` to layer atheris on demand via `uv run --with`.

## Why

Two longstanding pain points motivated this:

1. **`make test` required infrastructure setup** — `install-dev` had to run first, the venv had to be sourced, and pytest plugin pinning was scattered across the Makefile and CI workflows. Slower onboarding, harder-to-reason CI.
2. **Live-gateway tests were sprinkled across `tests/e2e/{mcp,sso}`, `tests/e2e_rust/`, and `tests/protocol_compliance/`** — `PYTEST_IGNORE` had four entries, each with its own justification. The split between in-process vs live-gateway tests was implicit and easy to miss.

Both are addressed by leaning harder on `uv` and by giving live-gateway tests a single, self-documenting home.

## What changed

### Makefile / pytest invocation

- ~30 pytest invocations migrated from `source $(VENV_DIR)/bin/activate && $(VENV_DIR)/bin/pytest ...` to `$(UV_BIN) run pytest ...`.
- Inline env-var prefixes replace `export X=Y &&` chains inside bash subshells.
- Every test target gains `uv` as an order-only dependency (verifies `uv` exists; skips `install-dev`).
- `--extra plugins` added to broad-scope targets (test, test-verbose, test-profile, coverage*, async-test, test-docs) so cpex_* plugin imports continue to resolve.
- New `test-live-gateway` umbrella target.
- New `# help:` entries for previously-undocumented targets (test-mcp-rbac, test-mcp-access-matrix, test-mcp-plugin-parity, test-mcp-session-isolation, test-e2e-sso, test-live-gateway).

### Test directory layout

```
tests/
├── e2e/                 # in-process FastAPI tests (default `make test`)
└── live_gateway/        # NEW — all live-infrastructure tests
    ├── README.md        # documents prereqs per subsuite
    ├── helpers/         # ← from tests/e2e/helpers/
    ├── mcp/             # ← from tests/e2e/mcp/ + 3 live-infra files lifted up from tests/e2e/
    ├── e2e_rust/        # ← from tests/e2e_rust/
    ├── sso/             # ← from tests/e2e/sso/
    └── protocol_compliance/  # ← from tests/protocol_compliance/
```

`PYTEST_IGNORE` collapses from 5 entries to 4 (`tests/fuzz tests/manual test.py tests/live_gateway` — three directory ignores plus the `test.py` stub file). `pyproject.toml` `addopts` likewise simplifies to a single `--ignore=tests/live_gateway`.

### Dependency reshuffling

- `pytest-html`, `pytest-playwright`, `playwright`, `python-owasp-zap-v2.4` moved from the `playwright` extra into `dev`.
- `hypothesis`, `pytest-benchmark`, `schemathesis` (with the existing pytest-9 cap) moved from the `fuzz` extra into `dev`.
- The `playwright`, `fuzz`, and `fuzz-atheris` extras are removed. `make fuzz-atheris` now layers atheris ad-hoc via `uv run --with 'atheris>=3.0.0'` — Linux gets the prebuilt wheel, macOS arm64 needs `brew install llvm` (documented in the target's help text).

### Side-fixes that fell out

- **Pytest-playwright auto-load conflict**: moving `pytest-playwright` into `dev` revealed that its session-scoped browser fixtures pollute the asyncio event loop and break `tests/e2e/test_oauth_protected_resource.py` and friends ("Runner.run() cannot be called from a running event loop"). Fix: `addopts = "... -p no:playwright"` globally; UI targets opt back in via `-p playwright` in the `run_playwright_test` macro.
- **Three empty stub files** (`test_admin_workflow.py`, `test_client_workflow.py`, `test_federation_workflow.py`) deleted from `tests/e2e/`.

### CI workflow path filters

`.github/workflows/pytest{,-rust}.yml` updated their `paths:` triggers to point at `tests/live_gateway/e2e_rust/**`.

## Verification

- `make test` (in-process subset): 168 passed, 2 skipped — the 2 skips are pre-existing `skipif` markers, not regressions.
- `tests/live_gateway/` collects cleanly across all 5 subsuites (mcp + sso + e2e_rust + protocol_compliance + helpers).
- `make help` shows the new umbrella + previously-undocumented targets.
- Both commits signed off (DCO). No pre-commit hooks bypassed.

## Notes for reviewers

- The big diff is mostly file renames (`R` flag in git) — content of moved tests is unchanged except for relative-import updates (`from .helpers` → `from ..helpers`) and a couple of black-driven reformats the pre-commit hook applied automatically.
- `.secrets.baseline` was updated by detect-secrets to follow the moved files; entry counts before/after are identical (1111 entries / 413 paths).
- `scripts/compliance_matrix.py` had two hardcoded path strings updated.
- The second commit (`chore: drop UAID design doc and trim detect-secrets-scan`) is unrelated cleanup bundled in because both were tiny chores sitting in the working tree.

commits.message:
refactor(tests): unify live-gateway dirs, use uv run

Tests requiring a live ContextForge gateway, an SSO IdP, the Rust
transport, or the protocol compliance harness now live under a single
tests/live_gateway/ tree (mcp/, sso/, e2e_rust/, protocol_compliance/,
helpers/). PYTEST_IGNORE collapses to one entry; a new
`make test-live-gateway` umbrella runs the whole tree.

Migrate every Makefile pytest target to `uv run pytest`: no more
`source venv/bin/activate`, no more `install-dev` prerequisite. Move
playwright and fuzz dependencies from optional-deps to the dev group;
extras are now reserved for production packaging options. Rewire
`fuzz-atheris` to use `uv run --with` so atheris (and its clang/
libfuzzer build dependency) is layered on demand.

Suppress pytest-playwright by default via `-p no:playwright`; UI
targets opt back in via `-p playwright`. The session-scoped browser
fixtures were polluting the asyncio event loop in unrelated async
tests ("Runner.run() cannot be called from a running event loop").

Add `--extra plugins` to broad-scope test targets so cpex_* plugin
imports continue to resolve under `make test`.

Delete three empty workflow stubs under tests/e2e/.

Signed-off-by: Jonathan Springer <jps@s390x.com>

commits.message:
chore(test): suppress pytest-benchmark globally to avoid xdist conflict

pytest-benchmark's single-process timing model conflicts with pytest-xdist
(`-n auto`/`-n N`) used by `make test` and friends — running both at once
either skews benchmark numbers or breaks worker dispatch.

Mirror the existing pytest-playwright pattern: suppress the plugin globally
via `-p no:benchmark` in pyproject.toml `addopts`, and opt back in only
where it's actually needed. `migration-test-performance` is the only
target whose stated purpose is benchmarking, and it already runs without
`-n`; add `-p benchmark` there so the plugin is available to those tests.

Document the suppress-then-opt-in pattern alongside the playwright comment
in run_playwright_test so future targets follow the same convention.

Signed-off-by: Jonathan Springer <jps@s390x.com>
commits.author: Jonathan Springer

commits.message:
fix(test): close post-review gaps in live-gateway reorg

Self-review surfaced four classes of missed cleanup after the test
reorganization landed:

* Five Makefile targets that exercise the pytest-playwright fixture
  (`test-mcp-rbac`, `test-e2e-sso`, `test-live-gateway`, `test-owasp`,
  `test-zap`) now opt back in via `-p playwright`. Without this they
  fail at collection because addopts globally suppresses the plugin.
* Three Makefile targets still ran pytest through an activated venv
  instead of `uv run` (`async-debug`, `migration-test-rollback`,
  `migration-test-cross-db`). Migrated to match the rest of the suite.
* Three install docs still pointed at extras that were removed by this
  PR (`docs/testing/fuzzing.md` for fuzz/fuzz-atheris,
  `tests/playwright/README.md` for playwright). Replaced with
  `make install-dev`/`make fuzz-atheris`.
* Both pytest CI workflows still carried a stale
  `--ignore=tests/e2e/test_entra_id_integration.py` line; the file
  moved to `tests/live_gateway/sso/` and the `addopts`
  `--ignore=tests/live_gateway` already covers it.

Plus the boring sweep:

* The `protocol_compliance` marker description, the `test_oauth_jwks_e2e`
  direct-run example, and ~25 doc/comment cross-references now point at
  the live_gateway paths.
* File-header `Location:` docstrings inside `tests/live_gateway/protocol_compliance/`
  rewritten in bulk (the rename was 100% similarity so headers had been
  silently stale).
* PR description updated: `PYTEST_IGNORE` is 4 paths (3 dirs + 1 stub
  file), not 2 as previously claimed.

Signed-off-by: Jonathan Springer <jps@s390x.com>
